title: AntiXray Lite
description: This plugin floods an Xrayer with random ores to prevent them from seeing  real ores whilst using little to no CPU and RAM usage
body:
## Better AntiXray
This plugin prevents Xray resourcepacks and mods from working by flooding the Xrayer with random ores.
____________________________________________________________________________

**What it does**
The plugin changes all unexposed stone, deepslate and netherack textures to random ores, this means that whenever someone uses an Xray resourcepack or mod, they will be bombarded by almost every texture being an ore meaning they will not be able to see the real ores ( Freecam does not bypass ).
